beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: On the night before everything changed, Jesus sat with his disciples and told them not to let their hearts be troubled.

timing.text: On the night before everything changed, Jesus sat with his disciples and told them not to let their hearts be troubled.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

timing.text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He was going somewhere — but not to leave them behind. He was going to get a place ready.

timing.text: He was going somewhere — but not to leave them behind.
He was going to get a place ready.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

timing.text: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you.
I go to prepare a place for you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A house with room for everyone. He said it plainly — if it were not true, he would have told them.

timing.text: A house with room for everyone.
He said it plainly — if it were not true, he would have told them.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

timing.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He was not describing a far-off maybe.

timing.text: He was not describing a far-off maybe.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He was promising to come back and carry them home himself.

timing.text: He was promising to come back and carry them home himself.

card.text: He went to prepare a place — and he's coming back for you. You are not forgotten.
